scope: The two complete binary coefficient sums. Each row is a specified product of physical face values and fully defined lower operations, with whole nonlinear scopes retained and their numerators explicitly listed. These counts are not a claim of global algebraic minimality.

checks: every factor reference and nonlinear scope
all explicit rows and duplicate removal
exact_table_validation.lossless_encoding: gzip is used only for JSON term arrays; decompressed arrays are the verified explicit coefficient tables

natural_operation_identities.domain: Actual total cochain inputs satisfy the lower tower. Individual formal Majorana components remain arbitrary. The unchanged lower stacking representative, its explicit off-tower correction, Bocksteins, integer carries and ordinary derivatives are evaluated independently.
natural_operation_identities.physical_origin: The designated exchange contributions are preserved before coordinate substitution; no reassignment by variable support.

verification_limit: Finite native readbacks supplement the exact coefficient construction and complete table validation; they are not a standalone proof for every physical group.
